Experiment-Agentic-Flow/mepworkspace.purpose: Angular/Nx monorepo for MEP (Mechanical, Electrical, Plumbing) solutions - dozens of apps (hcui, ecui, livecount, fabui, sxui, analytics-portal, admin-assist-portal, asset-iq-portal, ...) and shared libraries under libs/, organized by domain.

Experiment-Agentic-Flow/quantitytakeoffs.purpose: Authenticated ASP.NET Core API for managing 3D-model and manual quantity-takeoff data associated with estimates/jobs, including model versions, property-set definitions, takeoff items, merged properties, changesets, asynchronous deletion and save workflows, and real-time client notifications.
keyModules: Processor: business orchestration and request/domain mapping
Repositories: MongoDB persistence for models, takeoff items, manual takeoffs, changesets, merged properties, and customer storage details
Models: domain, request, response, view, configuration, enum, and validation types
MassTransitConsumers: asynchronous model-processing, deletion, save, and customer-data message handlers
CourierActivities: routing-slip activities for transactional save and deletion workflows
Services: Trimble file access, encryption, data protection, MongoDB transactions, indexes, and message data storage
SignalR/QuantityTakeoffHub: grouped real-time success and failure notifications
Extensions/ServiceCustomExtensions: dependency injection, authentication, messaging, SignalR, serialization, and infrastructure setup
notablePatterns: Controllers delegate to processors, processors orchestrate repositories and services, and repositories encapsulate MongoDB access.
Customer identity is obtained from authenticated HTTP claims and used in tenant-scoped queries.
Model and takeoff deletion uses soft-delete metadata, MongoDB sessions, and transaction helpers with compensation support.
MassTransit Azure Service Bus routing slips handle long-running save and deletion workflows.
Consumers publish success or failure notifications through a unified SignalR hub using client-provided group IDs.
Takeoff publishing replaces existing takeoff records for a job before inserting the submitted batch.
API versioning, customer/license authorization policies, FluentValidation integration, CORS, rate limiting, health checks, Swagger, and ReDoc are configured in the application pipeline.
JSON uses case-insensitive property matching, original property names, and string enum serialization.

Experiment-Agentic-Flow/quantitytakeoffo.purpose: Asynchronous service that consumes Trimble BIM model conversion messages, downloads and parses models, extracts quantity-takeoff elements and properties, uploads compressed JSON to Trimble File Service, updates MongoDB metadata, and publishes completion or failure events with SignalR notifications.
notablePatterns: MassTransit saga state machine with Converting, Completed, and Failed states
CorrelationId-based message correlation and MongoDB saga persistence
SignalR group notifications for progress, start, completion, and failure events
TrimBim model parsing followed by property and element extraction
Temporary streamed JSON generation, gzip compression, and chunked file upload
MongoDB upsert of file identifiers and property-set definitions
Customer data deletion through a CDH message consumer
Local Service Bus queue/topic names can be prefixed by the current username
AccessToken is read from a message header and Base64-decoded before model download
